study.question: Can the occupancy of each target-conditioned compressed slot determine when its local feedback rate should be trusted over the user-wide visible-history rate, improving the observed short/long-history and task trade-offs without additional learned capacity?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: g2-r0003-pooled_global has lower macro AUC than g2-r0003-pooled_local (0.8262190705 versus 0.8267496175), but better click/favorite AUC and macro Logloss; its macro AUC is slightly higher for histories1-16 and17-64 and lower for >64. Provisional mechanism: low-occupancy target-field slots have less reliable rates, while dense slots carry useful local specificity, especially for purchase. Set gate_s,t = n_s/(n_s+4)*f_s,t + 4/(n_s+4)*g_t only in the projected-content product, retaining raw local fractions separately. Actual slot occupancy and rate variance have NOT been measured; history length is only a proxy, and these data do not establish sampling noise as the cause.

nearest_work.difference: Closest implemented local model; candidate.py initially matched its f6bc523e source hash. Preserve its exact modules, routing, masked means and tower columns, changing only the deterministic rate used in the factorized content-feedback product.

The inspected history source and committed validation receipt replace local product gates by a single user-wide rate. Proposed interpolation is count-conditioned between these observed alternatives, not a new projection, feedback channel or label.

Exact-version primary text sections4.2-4.3, lines219-279 inspected: DIN uses target-conditioned event activation and unnormalized pooling. This study inherits the existing local compressed model rather than claiming DIN reproduction, and changes a post-compression feedback-rate product without event attention.

Pinned benchmark initialization/forward lines26-145 inspected: target-attention pooling precedes heterogeneous feature/task token interaction. Here fixed target-field slots and four existing MLP towers remain; only rate interpolation changes. The original HiFormer paper is not verified, and no priority claim or implementation equivalence is made.

study.proposed_difference: One deterministic replacement: multiply each existing projected slot content by a convex local/global feedback-rate mixture. Candidate local weight n/(n+4); fixed_blend uses0.5; reverse_count uses4/(n+4). Strength4 is a prospective modest pseudo-count, never tuned here. Global rate is computed per impression from the same masked100-history inputs and includes that slot, so it is a dependent shrinkage target, not an independent Bayesian prior. Empty-history products remain zero. local_bridge is a byte-identical original source/config control. No trainable parameters, new tower columns, attention layers, loss hooks, external features or source-derived industry architectures are added. This ordinary smoothing design is not claimed novel; the available-source search does not establish priority.
predictions: count_shrink exceeds local_bridge in validation macro AUC while retaining the measured parent advantage over DIN; per-task AUC/Logloss changes remain visible and no undeclared task veto is used.
For the reliability explanation, count_shrink exceeds fixed_blend AND reverse_count on macro AUC; beating only the raw parent supports interpolation at most, not count-dependent reliability.

Predeclared existing slices empty,1-16,17-64,>64: benefits relative to local_bridge are expected mainly in nonempty shorter histories, with less of the long-history purchase regression observed for pooled_global. Length slices are proxies, not proof about slot occupancy. Report sample and positive/negative counts and mark insufficient slices.

All variants retain 32288965 parameters (495749 dense) if host metadata matches the parent; interpolation adds only O(B*8*4) scalar arithmetic and no event-length neural projection. Cost is expected near parent253.65s training/286.62s total/10.36ms model-only batch p50; measured host costs, not estimates, determine the quality-cost conclusion.
falsifiers: If count_shrink does not improve local_bridge macro AUC under the frozen recipe, this implementation has not improved selection quality even if one task or Logloss improves.
If fixed_blend or reverse_count matches/exceeds count_shrink, evidence does not support the proposed direction of count-conditioned trust; a generic blending/scale effect remains sufficient.
If gain is confined to long histories or accompanied by the same long-history purchase loss as global gating, the proposed sparse-slot explanation is weakened even if macro selection improves.

Any masked-payload dependence, nonfinite empty-history forward/backward, change to predictions from target-action-only perturbations, or parameter mismatch invalidates the implementation comparison until corrected through the host; failed attempts remain charged.

One-seed differences, including the prior0.00005017 pooling-versus-legacy delta, cannot establish statistical significance, repeated support, or a general mechanism. Failure at pseudo-count4 does not refute all count-conditioned compression.
alternative_explanations: Local/global mixtures alter product amplitude and optimization conditioning; the MLP already receives raw fractions and counts and might learn equivalent interactions given a different training duration.
History-length slices differ in user activity, feature frequency and label prevalence; no slot-variance diagnostic or causal link from length to reliability has yet been measured.
Global rates include the same local events and can import unrelated category/brand behavior; self-inclusion and task heterogeneity may dominate any variance reduction.

The fixed and reverse controls match capacity and arithmetic scale, but their occupancy-weighted mixing doses differ. Positive results still require a dose-matched or occupied-slot permutation follow-up before strong attribution.
Shared seed/data ordering and unchanged registration reduce initialization confounding, but dense AdamW updates, BF16 rounding, single-seed variation and adaptive validation selection remain.

Offline action visibility may contain delayed feedback not mature in production. The auxiliary future24h cart/fav/buy labels match user/category/brand, not direct ad conversion; conclusions remain benchmark-specific.
